main_text.head: B
main_text.p: Balon, Cicatrices] Huic affine, & nostrum, & Teutonic. vet. Blowe, i.e. Alapa, ictus.
Baldo, & alibi Bolatico, Fiduciali-ter] Audax, Saxon. balo, audaciter, balolic, unde nostratium bold, & bold-lp. Hoc Teutonicis modernis boude, priscis autem, uti Sax. bald. Kilian.
Begtbte, Confessione: nos bichte. Vide begigan verbum, & Bief.
Befuicbetce, Scandalum] Æjpic, al. zerpic, & Æppicunge, Saxonibus scandalum, offendiculum: berpic autem eis pro fraude.

Billibires, Figuli: & Bebillte, Imagine] Saxon. Imago bilipe, Belgis beeld, Teuton. bilot. Saxon. modernis {*}similiter. Hinc autem forte no-* Gryphl. and. De Weichbild. Sax. c. 72.strum tlp, & bill, E. G. to knotw one bp bis blp, o} bill, i.e. ex vultus fui forma aliquem cognoscere.

The asterisk in the text is a reference mark. The right-margin note is transcribed from the scan. The word "rem" at the foot is treated as a catchword.
